name: What is the process for a condo remodel with your company?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a condo remodel with your company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our remodel process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we develop preliminary designs and provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, we assist with material selection and navigating HOA approvals and necessary permits. Construction then commences, managed by our experienced team, with regular communication. Finally, we conduct a walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction before project completion and handover.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design, estimate, material selection, HOA/permit navigation, construction, and a final walkthrough for satisfaction.
